text:
jamie: kicking off canary deploy for release/rc-2.1 now. primary change = new_search_ranking. plan: staged toggle with safety fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy job started (id: dj-3501). canary hosts: 4. rolling to canary cohort A (10%)

maria: tagging note - pin model-version 2025-03-05-01 for cohort A to avoid cold-start regressions.

alex: +1 on pin. propose ramp: 10% -> 30% after 10m if errors < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < +20ms.

ops: watch redis miss rate and prefix cache hit. if kv-cache miss > 12% during canary, hold and shout here. :eyes:

sre-bot: perf dash: <https://monitoring.internal/runs/dj-3501|dj-3501 metrics> (auto-updates every 30s)

jamie: feature flag API snippet for toggling cohorts:```bash
curl -X POST https://ff.internal/api/v1/toggles/new_search_ranking/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"cohorts": [{"name":"canary-A","percent":10,"pin_version":"2025-03-05-01"}], "route":"staged"}'
```

maria: i'm on infra watch for the next 20m, will call hold if error budget drains.

ops: putting soft holdpoint: if errors > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 delta > 30ms -> pause ramp and fallback to previous model.

riley: seeing a small uptick in tokenization errors on canary-A logs: `tokenize_failures: 8 -> 23` over last 3m. investigating.

jamie: pausing ramp, initiating canary drain to 0% for canary-A. fallback route -> previous-ranking.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered for dj-3501 (reason: tokenization error spike). rolling changes back to stable.

riley: root cause looks like a pretrained tokenizer mismatch in model-version 2025-03-05-01. reproducing locally.

alex: good catch. once fixed, let's re-run canary with smaller step: 5% -> 15% -> 40% and longer soak (15m) per step.

maria: noted for release notes: include rollback reason + pinned version details. adding to the changelog draft.

jamie: thanks all. filing postmortem note and will open a follow-up thread for the re-roll plan. :white_check_mark:
